csv_project_name: AE Services for WLU Softball Clubhouse Athletics Facilities
csv_scope_of_work: West Liberty University is soliciting expressions of interest for architectural/engineering services for a clubhouse at our existing softball field. This solicitation is to request expressions of interest from architectural firms for program review and refinement of the existing preliminary design and the services required to complete this building. The new facilities will include batting cages, offices, storage, and locker rooms for the West Liberty Hilltopper Softball Team.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Programming, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: AE Services for WLU Softball Clubhouse Athletics Facilities
short_description: Design services for a new softball clubhouse with support spaces at West Liberty University.
project_scope: Architectural and engineering services for a new clubhouse at the existing West Liberty University softball field. The facility will include batting cages, offices, storage areas, and locker rooms for the West Liberty Hilltopper Softball Team. The notice mentions review and refinement of an existing preliminary design, but no gross floor area, dimensions, spans, or capacity are stated.
services: Architectural and engineering services including program review and refinement of the existing preliminary design and completion of the building design. Requested disciplines include architecture, programming, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports-related building, which is generally of interest to sbp.
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary AE scope.
- However, the project is a relatively small clubhouse rather than a stadium, arena, or long-span sports structure.
- No special structural features, large spans, innovative materials, or sustainability ambitions are described.
- Early design-stage involvement is possible through refinement of the preliminary design, which adds some strategic value.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope information: new softball clubhouse at an existing field with batting cages, offices, storage, and locker rooms. This suggests a small to medium sports support building, but no reliable USD estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. The notice is only for expressions of interest for multidisciplinary AE services and does not state construction cost, fee basis, or scope by phase in enough detail for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Expressions of interest are requested from architectural firms for AE services. Specific minimum reference requirements, number of references, fee zones, or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
contracting_authority: West Liberty University, West Liberty, WV, USA. Contact: Patrick Kelly. Phone: 304-336-8510. Email: patrick.kelly@westliberty.edu. Website: https://westliberty.edu/business-office/eoi-26-0004-softball-clubhouse/
notes: Project number 26-004. Questions deadline: 06/02/2026 03:00 PM EDT. Contract duration indicated as 12-month base period with 48-month renewal option; renewable: yes. The notice appears to be an RFQ/RFP for expressions of interest and emphasizes architectural firms leading a multidisciplinary team.
